TEXT: Breakfast.
At the table was me, Kirino, Dad, Mom...
And finally, Kanako too.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: I see, so Kanako's joining us for breakfast today.

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT: Yup! Ah, I mean, yes!

If she doesn't keep up the act, there's no way she 
can stay polite.

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT: Umm.

SPEAKER: SPK_YOSHINO
TEXT: I invited her. I thought it'd be good to eat together.

SPEAKER: SPK_YOSHINO
TEXT: That's fine with you, Dad?

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: Yeah.
Kirino's still in a foul mood.
She won't make eye contact with Kanako.

SPEAKER: SPK_EVERYBODY
TEXT: Thank you for the food!

Today's breakfast menu consists of meat and 
potato stew, spinach with sesame seed dressing, 
ending with miso soup.
It felt more like a Japanese meal than usual.

I silently scooped rice and meat into my mouth 
with my chopsticks.

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT: *stare*

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: What's wrong, staring at me like that?

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT: N-Nothing.

SPEAKER: SPK_YOSHINO
TEXT: How does the food taste today, Kyousuke?

SPEAKER: SPK_YOSHINO
TEXT: I decided to change up the usual spices.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Ah, now that you mention it... It doesn't quite taste 
like the usual.

SPEAKER: SPK_YOSHINO
TEXT: Delicious, isn't it?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
I wouldn't go as far as to say it's delicious. It's 
average.

SPEAKER: SPK_YOSHINO
TEXT: Who do you think you are!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Whoa... I mean, there's no point if I wasn't honest 
about my impressions of the food!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: R-Right, Dad?

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: Yeah.

SPEAKER: SPK_YOSHINO
TEXT: How about you, Dad? How is it?

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: The taste of the food? Well, average.

SPEAKER: SPK_YOSHINO
TEXT: Kirino?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: The potatoes are way too mushy.

...Geez Mom, why are you so desperate for a 
compliment?

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: ...But you know, Kyousuke, you're lucky.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Eh?

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
Back when we first got married, your mom's 
cooking was absolutely terrible.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
This meat and potato stew can't even compare to 
it.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: I-I see...

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: Yeah, it wasn't something edible.

SPEAKER: SPK_YOSHINO
TEXT: Oh my, is that sooo~?

SPEAKER: SPK_YOSHINO
TEXT:
Oh Dad, do you really want to have a couple's 
quarrel this early in the morning?

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: I don't mean it like that.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
From then on, Mom practiced cooking until she 
could cook normal tasting food.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: All for the sake of our family.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: I see. Well then, I'll have to be grateful for the food.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: Yeah.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
You're very lucky that "this" has been edible from 
the start for you.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: Be grateful while you eat.

We all gratefully ate the food of the person who 
made the mushy potatoes.
